heroSection.heroSubtitle: Centered on "Equipment Rental + Financing Cooperation + Maintenance Services", we provide equipment asset configuration solutions for international oil companies, international oilfield service companies, and large-scale engineering projects.

mainSection.sectionBody:
Option 1: Oil Equipment Rental. Operating lease of oil equipment with flexible cooperation term negotiation
Option 2: Rent-to-Own. Rent-to-own equipment with installment payment
Option 3: Consortium Approach. Joint project execution, integrated package financing, and subcontracting by agreement

cards.title: Equipment Rental
cards.summary:
Operating lease of oil equipment with flexible cooperation term negotiation
1. Flexible lease term; 2. Improve cash flow; 3. Eliminate large fixed asset investment risks; 4. Enhance project efficiency

cards.title: Rent-to-Own
cards.summary: The customer pays rent periodically, and ownership of the equipment is transferred upon full payment.
